rationale: The candidate fails the gymnasium program contract. In all four views it reads as a small, highly fractured, irregularly faceted cluster rather than one clear long-span hall with subordinate support. The top and oblique views show a near-circular jagged mass with many colliding slices and no dominant clear-span volume; the front view also reads as layered fragments rather than a single hall datum. There is no legible public void, court, undercut, or entry seam on the verified frontage, so the access edge is sealed semantically. The silhouette is not a coherent stepped or profiled sports section; it is instead an arbitrary serrated stack, closer to a torqued sculptural object than a gym. Because the visible mass erases the dominant hall relation and does not support roof-span/daylight logic, program_fit_hard_pass must fail.
